categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: construction (55.63% revenue share), contracting/construction services (38.2%), and department store operations (6.17%). The construction segment focuses on residential and commercial real estate development, including urban renewal and mixed-use projects. The contracting segment undertakes building, civil engineering, and infrastructure projects mainly for government and private clients. The department store segment manages shopping centers and retail operations, including online sales platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced construction technologies including green building design, low-carbon materials, and smart building systems. It integrates BIM (Building Information Modeling) combined with AI for project management and greenhouse gas accounting. The contracting division uses ERP systems, mobile CCTV, AR interactive videos, and construction automation research to enhance efficiency and quality. The department store segment leverages AI-powered digital retail platforms and OMO (Online-Merge-Offline) strategies for customer engagement.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include individual homebuyers and commercial tenants for the construction segment, government agencies and private corporations (notably electronics and technology firms) for contracting projects, and general consumers for department store retail. Major markets are urban metropolitan areas in Taiwan, especially Taipei, New Taipei, Taoyuan, and Taichung. The company also serves public infrastructure projects and high-tech industrial clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan, with major activities in Taipei City, New Taipei City, Taoyuan City, and Taichung City. The contracting division serves projects across Taiwan island. The department store business operates eight shopping centers located in key urban and transit hub locations throughout Taiwan. There is no significant overseas operation reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily midstream and downstream in the real estate and construction supply chain. It is involved in land acquisition, design, construction, and property management (downstream). The contracting division acts as a midstream construction service provider coordinating upstream suppliers of materials and subcontractors. The department store segment is downstream retail, sourcing products from various suppliers and selling directly to consumers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include sustainable development with a focus on low-carbon, green building, and smart technologies. The company has established an ESG governance framework and sustainability committee overseeing climate risk management and carbon reduction targets aligned with SBTi. R&D initiatives focus on BIM+AI integration, construction automation, circular economy practices, and digital retail innovation. The company plans to expand renewable energy use and enhance digital customer engagement.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through real estate sales and leasing (construction segment), contracting fees from government and private construction projects (contracting segment), and retail sales including rental income from tenants and direct sales in department stores. The department store segment also earns from online retail platforms. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading integrated real estate developer and construction contractor in Taiwan with a strong reputation for quality and sustainability. It competes with other major construction and real estate firms in Taiwan, leveraging its diversified business model across construction, contracting, and retail. Its contracting division is a top-tier Grade A contractor with ISO certifications and recognized industry awards. The department store segment competes in a crowded retail market by focusing on transit hub locations and digital integration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue growth of 47.5% from NT$19.44 billion in 2022 to NT$28.68 billion in 2023. Net profit attributable to owners increased by 132% to NT$5.55 billion, with earnings per share rising from NT$4.42 to NT$10.25. Total assets are approximately NT$58.13 billion with shareholders' equity of NT$28.2 billion, reflecting a solid financial base and steady growth trajectory. Cash flow metrics improved significantly in 2023 due to strong sales and project completions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes integrity, quality, service, innovation, and sustainability as core values. It differentiates through high-quality, refined residential and commercial developments incorporating green and smart building technologies. Its integrated business model covers the full real estate lifecycle, providing comprehensive services from land acquisition to after-sales. The department store segment offers convenient, one-stop shopping experiences at transit hubs combined with digital retail innovation. Commitment to ESG and community engagement further strengthens its brand and customer loyalty.
